records.text: Vine and Fig Tree is a pro-Israel organization with ties to the administration and met with Sebastian Gorka at the White House earlier this year.
records.speaker: Gabrielle Cuccia

appearances.snippet: There's a company called Vine and Fig Tree, VFT. ... VFT is a pro-Israel organization with ties to the administration. Earlier this year, VFT was at the White House meeting with Sebastian Gorka.

verification.notes: IRS-derived nonprofit data confirms VFT is a 501(c)(3) whose stated mission includes countering antisemitism and hate. Cuccia publicly alleged a White House meeting with Sebastian Gorka, but no official visitor record or independent confirmation of that meeting was found.

sources.relevance: IRS-derived profile confirms nonprofit status and stated counter-antisemitism mission.

records.text: Shortly after VFT's White House meeting, I was contacted through a third party and asked to write scripts for VFT.
records.speaker: Gabrielle Cuccia

appearances.snippet: Shortly after that White House meeting, I was contacted through a third party and asked to script write for VFT.

verification.notes: Cuccia publicly gave this first-person account and multiple reports reproduce it. The contact and script request were private, so the underlying messages have not been independently authenticated.

sources.title: Trump Administration Targets Americans Opposed to Zionism
sources.relevance: Reproduces Cuccia first-person account that VFT contacted her for script writing after the alleged meeting.

records.text: I received a Dropbox link with VFT research, polling data, internal comments, and strategy material; it contained seven folders.
records.speaker: Gabrielle Cuccia

appearances.snippet: I was then given a Dropbox link containing research, polling data, internal comments and strategy material compiled by VFT and the third party involved. ... Inside the Dropbox were seven folders.

verification.notes: Cuccia publicly described receiving a Dropbox with seven folders and summarized its contents; multiple reports reproduce the account. The full Dropbox and provenance have not been independently authenticated.

sources.title: Trump Administration Targets Americans Opposed to Zionism
sources.relevance: Reproduces Cuccia description of a Dropbox containing seven folders and research material.

records.text: VFT reports monitor major conservative and dissident-right accounts and frequently frame those accounts as vulnerable to or participating in foreign influence operations.
records.speaker: Gabrielle Cuccia

appearances.snippet: Their reports monitor major conservative and dissident right accounts, and they frequently frame those accounts as vulnerable to or participating in. ... In foreign influence operations

verification.notes: Contemporary reporting describes leaked VFT documents that monitor right-wing accounts and frame some as linked or vulnerable to foreign influence. The documents support the reported content, but their provenance has not been independently verified.

sources.title: Covert Domestic Influence: How the White House is Using Disinformation Tactics on American Citizens
sources.relevance: Reports that leaked VFT documents monitored right-wing influencers, networks, and vulnerabilities, while flagging lack of independent authentication.

records.text: Distrust surrounding Charlie Kirk's assassination was mostly caused by Americans falling for Russian, Iranian, and Pakistani propaganda networks.
records.speaker: Vine & Fig Tree Institute I, Inc.

appearances.snippet: In another report, they argue that distrust surrounding Charlie Kirk's assassination was mostly due to Americans falling for Russian, Iranian, and Pakistani propaganda networks.

verification.notes: Transcript context shows this was a claim attributed to a VFT report, and reporting confirms Cuccia said the report made it. No independent evidence establishes the causal assertion that foreign propaganda mostly caused public distrust.

records.text: This represents an urgent national security threat and demands a whole-of-government response on par with cyber attacks or terrorism.
records.speaker: Vine & Fig Tree Institute I, Inc.

appearances.snippet: In that same Charlie Kirk report, they state, quote, this represents an urgent national security threat and demands a whole-of-government response on par with cyber attacks on terrorism.

records.text: VFT internal comments discuss going after Nick Fuentes by undermining his Christian identity and contemplate getting Matt Walsh or Michael Knowles to publish on VFT's behalf.
records.speaker: Gabrielle Cuccia

appearances.snippet: The internal comments attached to these reports are what stood out most. They talk about going after Fuentes, stating that undermining his Christian identity is probably a good idea. They contemplate getting Matt Walsh or Michael Knowles to publish on behalf of VFT.

verification.notes: The source episode and subsequent reporting attribute these internal-comment passages to leaked VFT material. The quoted content is consistently reported, but the original files and authorship are not independently authenticated.

sources.title: The World Is A Stage: Trump Survives...Again? | Ep 343
sources.relevance: Primary episode presentation of the alleged internal-comment passages concerning Fuentes, Walsh, and Knowles.

records.text: Tell politicians that there are two wings of the party, they do not overlap, the majority lies here, and this is where they should be if they want to be reelected.

appearances.snippet: There is definitely a way to use this in our favor. ... Tell politicians that there are two wings of the party, they don't overlap, and the majority lies here. ... And this is where you should be if you want to get reelected

records.speaker: Gabrielle Cuccia

appearances.snippet: The documents also discuss burner profiles, burner ad accounts, AI-generated interview-style videos, audience personas, troll content briefs, engagement testing, and ideological audience segmentation.

verification.notes: Reporting on the leaked VFT documents confirms discussion of burner accounts, AI-generated media, message testing, audience segmentation, and related tactics. Independent authentication of the complete document set remains outstanding.
